identity_law: An arrangement of responsibilities and flows; it has no independent adoption, authority or service promise.
Selectable behavior offered through a typed contract; it is not an adoption boundary by itself.
A versioned code artifact that may satisfy contracts after conformance evidence.
A published command, query, event or port contract owned by another artifact.
A composable semantic, algorithm, policy, oracle, port or runtime boundary with all decisions exposed.
An independently owned product outside the lakehouse suite that is imported through a contract.
A governed independently consumable outcome promise with user, adoption, lifecycle, authority, service, evidence and exit boundaries.
A family of external runtime offers selected by requirements and qualification evidence.
A finite metered runtime resource with capacity, cost and failure dimensions.
Owned vocabulary, equality, invariants, state transitions and refusals.
Vertical vocabulary, rules, mappings, defaults and recipes over horizontal products and capabilities.
Published interoperability language with explicit edition and compatibility laws.
Commercial or internal packaging of products; containment never transfers semantic ownership.
